comment: Second-incarnation copy (Compass Phase 5; Cycle Ladder §15, CD 2026-07-15). {F1}/{A2}/{B1}/{E1} are phrase-book phrases from the PRIOR life. §9.2 GUARD, binding: none of these lines may render at a1_consent or inside the Vigil — a returning player's Vigil is as archetypal as their first. The engine enforces this by having no a1 template at all. greeting_return is the first-return line; greeting_returns_deeper[i] varies the intro on the 3rd/4th/5th-and-beyond visit so looping does not go stale (Hades: returning is part of continuing) and the desk grows incrementally more candid — seeing one more seam each time — without ever naming the game outright. nudge_a2 is the curiosity 'thumb on the scale': shown only when a soul has repeated the SAME first-encounter choice across every past life, it names a door never opened. Framed as curiosity, never correctness (Compass §15 invariant).
greeting_return:
The desk remembers a soul shaped like you.
Last incarnation, you {F1}. The forms have been adjusted
accordingly — which is to say: not at all, and yet.
greeting_returns_deeper:
Twice now. The desk is developing what it is expressly
forbidden from calling a fondness. Last time, you {F1}. The
notice below has not changed. You have. Read it anyway — the
ritual was always the point, not the news.

Three. At three, the manual says, a returning soul stops
being an anomaly and becomes a pattern, and patterns are
permitted to be spoken to plainly. Last time, you {F1}. You
may notice the desk is standing a little off its script
today.

Again, and welcome. We are past counting now, which suits
the desk — it was never any good at counting the things that
mattered. Last time, you {F1}. The forms are the same. The
light is the same. The only variable this room has ever had
is you. So: what are you curious about this time?
greeting_recognized:
You again — and the desk is not going to pretend, this time,
that it does not know you. We settled that. Last life, you
{F1}.

The form is the same. I am not, quite. You changed the one
thing in this room that was ever available to change, which
was how the clerk holds its own face. So come in. Let us
play the one we both know we are playing.
greeting_long_absence:
(Considerable Earth time has elapsed. Locally, no time has
passed. The Department apologizes for any inconvenience.)
greeting_omega:
You came back.

Surprising. Most who leave the way you did do not revisit
this place.

Welcome back. Shall we begin again?

Again and… again?

Well. This is very rare indeed. The exception has been
caught, re-caught, and filed under RECURRING MIRACLES,
MINOR.

The desk has stopped being surprised, which surprises it.

Come in. Your door is where you left it — nowhere,
everywhere, and so on. The kettle, against policy, is on.
nudge_a2:
You have stood at this light before, and every time you
{A2_ALWAYS}. The door marked [ {A2_UNTAKEN} ] has never once
had your hand on it. I am not saying it is the better door —
the desk does not rank doors. I am saying curiosity is the one
currency this place cannot counterfeit, and you appear to have
some to spend.

node_lines.a2_light:
The light has arranged itself differently this time.
It remembers you. Last time, you {A2}.
node_lines.b1_beverage_cart:
The cart slows as it passes you. Last time, you {B1}.
The seventh cup regards you with something like recognition.
node_lines.e1_reciprocity:
You have stood at this question before. You {E1}.
I have been thinking about it ever since. I have had nothing
else to do between your visits — see above.
node_lines.f1_verbs:
For the record that keeps no names: last time, you {F1}.
The form does not rank. It does, however, notice.
